name: motion-beat-grid
title: Beat Grid
description: Các chấm sáng lần lượt theo phách 120 BPM, phách mạnh đầu ô nhịp loé màu; đặt thay đổi lên phách, sự kiện lớn lên phách mạnh.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 120 BPM grid (beat 500 ms, bar 2000 ms; frames per beat = 60 / BPM × fps, 15 at 30 fps): four dots light in turn, the active one growing r 18 → 30 px and decaying as e^(−6·beat phase); the downbeat dot is accent and a 25 % accent full-frame flash decays as e^(−8·phase); a 16-step ruler playhead runs over the bar. Params: bpm (120) · beats_per_bar (4) · flash (25 %). Frames per beat = 60 / BPM × fps (15 at 30 fps): put changes on beats and big events on downbeats.
